task.expected_outcome: Discount codes are trimmed before validation; invalid codes show an inline error message instead of failing silently.

in_scope: Trim whitespace on discount code input

An invalid code shows an inline error instead of silently failing

task.title: Fix intermittent 500 on token refresh endpoint
task.summary: The token refresh endpoint returns HTTP 500 under conditions not detailed in the issue body, but a maintainer comment narrows it to expired refresh tokens.
task.objective: Token refresh should fail gracefully (4xx) instead of erroring (5xx) on invalid/expired tokens.
task.description: Issue body only states the symptom. A maintainer comment thread clarifies the 500 occurs specifically when the refresh token itself has expired, which should be a client error, not a server error.
task.expected_outcome: Expired refresh tokens return a 401 with a clear error code instead of a 500.

in_scope: Catch expired-token case in refresh handler

acceptance_criteria: Refreshing with an expired token returns 401, not 500
Response body includes a machine-readable error code for 'refresh_token_expired'
constraints: Must not change the response shape for the success path

role.evidence: Issue concerns a server endpoint's HTTP status code behavior

components.evidence: Maintainer comment names the refresh handler as the source of the 500

expected_outcome.evidence: Maintainer comment states expired tokens should be a client error, implying 401 semantics

complexity.evidence: Fix is localized to one handler's error path once cause is known via context

experience_level.evidence: Requires correct HTTP semantics and existing error-handling conventions, but no new subsystem design

inferred_information.evidence: Localized fix once cause is known

uncertain_information.evidence: No indication of team's existing error-handling conventions
uncertain_information.note: Confidence kept at 0.55; could shift with repo access in a later phase.

missing_information: Whether other token-validation failure modes have the same 500 bug
